phase: CD-3C — SW2 Divergence Decomposition (third sublayer of CD-3)
authority: user GO ruling 2026-10-04: three questions exactly; RETROSPECTIVE_GROUPING semantics isolated (explanation/structure/L3-usefulness ONLY, never feeds CD-3B validation or L2 thresholds)
semantic_label: ALL SW2 historical decomposition outputs carry classification_mode=RETROSPECTIVE_CURRENT_SW2 (sw2_v1_static_declared, membership_change_frequency=UNKNOWN)
sw2_daily_returns: per (sw2 industry, date): equal-weight mean of member qfq daily returns (members traded that day, >=5 participating members else SUB-industry day = NULL); built from DATA-1 x sw2_v1 membership — same operator family as CD-1B axis_1, retrospective label
q1_divergent_split: on L2 DIVERGENT days: cross-SW2-child return dispersion measured as (max-min) range and std across children with >=5 participants (>=2 children required); comparison pool = same-sector, same-year, same-regime-tercile NON-DIVERGENT days (reusing CD-3B edges); report median range/std episode-free day-level distributions, dev/holdout separately; ANSWER YES if DIVERGENT median range > pool median range in BOTH splits
q2_narrow_leadership: on NARROW_STRENGTH+HIGH_CONCENTRATION days: compute SW2-child positive-contribution shares (child eq return x child volume, positive part); top1_share and top2_share of total positive contributions (>=2 children with positive return); ANSWER YES if median top2_share >= 0.6 in both splits (1-2 sub-industries dominate)
q3_broad_agreement: on L2 BROAD_STRENGTH days: fraction of participating SW2 children with positive return (>=3 children); ANSWER 'L2 breadth faithful' if median child-positive-fraction >= 0.8 in both splits, else 'L2 breadth masks sub-industry structure'
prohibited: SW2 results flowing into forward validation
using Q1/Q2/Q3 to adjust CD-2 states
